name: Data Analysis Investigation
description: Question-first analysis with provenance, alternative explanations, and sensitivity checks.

tasks.name: Define analysis contract
tasks.objective: State the decision/question, unit of analysis, population, period, outcome/metrics, comparison, causal vs descriptive intent, known confounders, and what result would change the decision.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Metric definitions and denominators are explicit before computation.

tasks.name: Audit data provenance and quality
tasks.objective: Trace source systems and transformations; quantify missingness, duplicates, coverage, schema drift, censoring, selection, unit/encoding/time-zone issues, and values that double as sentinels.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Known data limitations are quantified where possible.

tasks.name: Explore distributions and relationships
tasks.objective: Compute descriptive summaries, distributions, segments, time patterns, outliers, correlations, and visual diagnostics without fishing for a preferred result. Generate competing explanations for apparent patterns.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Exploration distinguishes data errors, real heterogeneity, and hypothesis-generating patterns.

tasks.name: Test competing hypotheses
tasks.objective: Choose models/tests appropriate to design and data-generating process. Report effect sizes and uncertainty, not just thresholded significance, and avoid causal language unless identification assumptions are defensible.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Method assumptions and comparison set are explicit.

tasks.name: Run sensitivity and falsification checks
tasks.objective: Vary reasonable definitions, windows, inclusion rules, model forms, missing-data treatment, influential points, and subgroup boundaries. Check whether conclusions survive plausible alternatives.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Fragile conclusions are labeled as fragile instead of averaged into confidence.

tasks.name: Produce reproducible report
tasks.objective: Create concise findings, charts with honest scales/denominators, methods, uncertainty, data caveats, alternative explanations, reproducible calculations, and decision implications separated from factual results.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Every reported number can be traced to data, definition, and computation.
